description: Lists the published Strategic Assessments in the connected account, newest first, with their ids, the Diagnostic each was based on, client_id and dates. Only published assessments appear: one that is booked or still being written appears once it is published, so an empty page does not mean none was ordered. Filters: client_id and diagnostic_report_id. A Strategic Assessment is a written walkthrough of a Diagnostic's findings, prepared with the business: which matter and what to fix first.
